info.description:
LUNARIS — Lunar Mission Intelligence & Surface Operations Platform.

Milestone 01 API: service health, scientific toolchain report, dataset registry with
local provenance status, and a registry of user-defined candidate sites.

Conventions: snake_case fields; units as suffixes (`_deg`, `_m`, `_s`, `_bytes`);
timestamps ISO 8601 UTC; coordinates planetocentric in the MOON_ME frame with east
longitude in [0, 360). Every non-2xx response uses the `ErrorResponse` envelope.

LUNARIS is a preliminary mission-planning and research tool, not a certified
spacecraft landing system.
info.summary: Lunar Mission Intelligence & Surface Operations Platform
info.title: LUNARIS API

get.description:
Every dataset LUNARIS knows about, with provenance metadata, URL verification
status and whether it is present in the local data store. Status is computed from
file presence and sizes; full checksum verification is done with
``lunaris-data verify``.
get.summary: Registered datasets and their local acquisition status

post.description:
Register a site by planetocentric coordinates in MOON_ME. Longitude is normalized to
[0, 360). Site names are unique (case-insensitive).

409.description: Duplicate name or registry limit reached.

get.description:
Apparent azimuth, elevation, range, angular radius and MOON_ME direction of the Sun
and the Earth from the site, every ``step_s`` seconds from ``start_utc`` to
``end_utc``. Computed locally with NAIF SPICE (DE440, corrections CN+S). At most
10 000 samples per request; more gives 422 ``sample_cap_exceeded``.

Liveness/readiness of the API. Returns 200 when every check passes, 503 otherwise.

Checks are cheap and side-effect free: a ``SELECT 1`` on the database, presence of
the data directory, and the number of loaded dataset manifests.
